"""Synthetic parser/scope controls; no native program, dataset or clock is run."""
from pathlib import Path
import copy, hashlib, importlib.util, json, sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True

ROOT=Path('/workspace/classical-ecdlp-validation-ready')
OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def module(name,path):
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,ROOT/path)
    m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m);return m
A=module('review_sweep_analysis','harness/classical_ecdlp_parameter_sweep/analysis.py')
E=module('review_sweep_engine','harness/classical_ecdlp_parameter_sweep/engine.py')
identity=('synthetic-cell','synthetic-curve',0,'harvest')
ids=['synthetic-'+str(i) for i in range(64)]
def vector(g):
    return {'group_additions':g,'scalar_multiplications':13,'field_additions':97,
            'field_multiplications':193,'field_inversions':7}
def row(kind,g,**other):
    return {'schema':A.NATIVE_SCHEMA,'scope':A.NATIVE_SCOPE,'cell_id':identity[0],
            'fixture':identity[1],'replicate':0,'arm':identity[3],
            'row_kind':kind,'counters':vector(g),**other}
rows=[row('fixture_validation',100,target_count=64),row('setup',10)]
rows += [row('target',2,target_ordinal=i,target_id=ids[i],status='solved',verified_scalar=1)
         for i in range(64)]
public_fixture={'p':383,'a':261,'b':146,'r':181,'P':[196,297],'Q':[196,297],'x':1}
assert (297*297-196*196*196-261*196-146)%383==0
# The group identity [1]P=P gives a correct public witness without running a solver.
assert public_fixture['x']==1 and public_fixture['P']==public_fixture['Q']
panel=A.summarize_stream(rows,ids,identity)
full=panel['prefixes']['64']['full_native_counters']['group_additions']
solver=panel['prefixes']['64']['solver_api_counters']['group_additions']
assert full==238 and solver==138
assert panel['prefixes']['1']['full_native_counters']['group_additions']==112
# Counterfabrication deliberately keeps the answer and every scalar witness identical.
mutated=copy.deepcopy(rows);mutated[2]['counters']['group_additions']+=1
changed=A.summarize_stream(mutated,ids,identity)
changed_total=changed['prefixes']['64']['full_native_counters']['group_additions']
assert changed_total==239
assert [r.get('verified_scalar') for r in rows]==[r.get('verified_scalar') for r in mutated]
omitted=A.summarize_stream(rows[1:],ids,identity)
assert omitted['output_complete'] is False
assert omitted['prefixes']['64']['full_native_counters'] is None
duplicate_error=None
try:A.summarize_stream([rows[0]]+rows,ids,identity)
except ValueError as exc:duplicate_error=str(exc)
assert duplicate_error=='duplicate counted validation/setup phase'
class Cohort:
    settings={f'cell-{i}':{} for i in range(128)}
    nonce_hex='0'*64
schedule=E.build_schedule(Cohort(),'f'*64)
rho=[x for x in schedule if x[1:] == ('shared','rho_reference')]
assert len(schedule)==5248 and len(rho)==128 and len(set(rho))==128
# A copy of an actual shared-reference record cannot masquerade as a new identity.
child={'arm_id':'shared.rho_reference','fixture_id':'synthetic-curve','replicate':0}
copy_error=None
try:A.summarize([child,dict(child)],'f'*64,'0'*64,repetitions=1,variants=(),expected_curves=1)
except ValueError as exc:copy_error=str(exc)
assert copy_error=='duplicate observed execution identity'
hash_checks=[]
manifest=json.loads((ROOT/'harness/classical_ecdlp_parameter_sweep/source-manifest.json').read_text())
for name,expected in manifest['files'].items():
    path=ROOT/'harness/classical_ecdlp_parameter_sweep'/name
    actual=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    hash_checks.append({'path':str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),'expected':expected,'actual':actual,'matches':actual==expected})
assert all(x['matches'] for x in hash_checks)
vend=ROOT/'harness/classical_ecdlp_endpoint_reuse/implementation'
vchecks=[]
for f in json.loads((vend/'vendor-source.json').read_text())['files']:
    actual=hashlib.sha256((vend/f['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    vchecks.append({'path':str((vend/f['path']).relative_to(ROOT)),'expected':f['sha256'],'actual':actual,'matches':actual==f['sha256']})
assert all(x['matches'] for x in vchecks)
protocol=json.loads((ROOT/'experiments/EXP-ECDLP-f50061/protocol.json').read_text())
manifest_sha=hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'harness/classical_ecdlp_parameter_sweep/source-manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert manifest_sha==protocol['extensions']['parameter_sweep']['source_manifest_sha256']
body={k:v for k,v in protocol.items() if k!='freeze'}
# The frozen protocol uses the package's canonical encoding; this is metadata verification only.
protocol_digest=hashlib.sha256(A.canonical(body)).hexdigest()
assert protocol_digest==protocol['freeze']['protocol_sha256']
result={
 'kind':'synthetic_software_controls_and_source_hashes_only','native_execution_performed':False,
 'control_command':'python3 controls.py','source_imports':[str(Path(A.__file__).relative_to(ROOT)),str(Path(E.__file__).relative_to(ROOT))],
 'controls':[
 {'id':'C-formula','input':'V=100,S=10,64*T=2; other nested diagnostics nonzero','expected_full_native':238,'observed_full_native':full,'observed_solver_api':solver,'full_prefix1':112,'verdict':'holds'},
 {'id':'C-advertised-plus-one','mutation':'first target group_additions += 1; all scalar answers unchanged','symbolic_expected':238,'parsed_mutant':changed_total,'parser_rejects_fabricated_native_count':False,'cost_certification':'inconclusive without independent native event replay','false_advertisement':'239 is rejected as a faithful report of the stipulated238-event ledger; witness validity cannot resolve the discrepancy','verdict':'holds'},
 {'id':'C-omitted-validation','false_full_native_advertisement':138,'correct_symbolic_full_native':238,'native_parser_output_complete':omitted['output_complete'],'full_native_vector':None,'verdict':'holds'},
 {'id':'C-duplicate-validation','exception':duplicate_error,'verdict':'holds'},
 {'id':'C-shared-rho-copy','schedule_slots':len(schedule),'shared_reference_slots':len(rho),'unique_shared_reference_slots':len(set(rho)),'duplicate_identity_exception':copy_error,'fake_eight_copy_count':1024,'actual_registered_reference_slots':128,'verdict':'holds'},
 {'id':'C-selected-winner','synthetic_same_panel_ratios':[0.95,1.05,0.94,1.06,0.96,1.04,0.93,1.07],'selected_ratio':0.93,'selected_setting_confirmed':False,'decision':'same-panel selection and pointwise intervals do not qualify a winner; no holdout/familywise control was run','verdict':'holds'}],
 'public_witness_fixture':public_fixture,'witness_equation':'[1]P=P (group identity; no native solver execution)',
 'source_manifest_sha256':manifest_sha,'protocol_sha256':protocol_digest,'sweep_hash_checks':hash_checks,
 'vendor_hash_checks':vchecks,'hashes_attest_execution':False,'clock_qualification':False}
(OUT/'control-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'controls':len(result['controls']),'sweep_hashes_match':len(hash_checks),'vendor_hashes_match':len(vchecks),'native_execution_performed':False,'full':full,'solver':solver}))
